27:t_1:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That was mean, $$アルト$$! Why did you go out to fight and leave us behind in Japan!?」

27:t_1:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Director $$大塚$$ told us you were fighting on the Central Asian front.」

27:t_1:10.en:
$n
「I'm sorry we left without telling you. We wanted you to defend Japan.」

27:t_1:11.en:
$n
「$$シンジ$$ and the others are back at $$ＮＥＲＶ$$, and $$カレン$$ and $$竜馬$$ are away from Japan. We couldn't send you away, too.」

27:t_1:12.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Come on... If you'd told us that from the start, I would've understood.」

27:t_1:13.en:
$n
「I'm sorry. I'll treat you to $$トライデント焼き$$ next time, so forgive me.」

27:t_1:14.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You promise! If you forget, I won't forgive you.」

27:t_1:17.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...Well, we have to get to school. Excuse us. But next time, we're definitely going out to fight, too.」

27:t_1:18.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「See you, everyone! Say hi to Miss $$スズネ$$ for us!」

27:t_1:21.en:
$$アルト$$
「You may have fooled $$ワッ太$$, but it looks like $$正太郎$$ saw through you.」

27:t_1:22.en:
$n
「I don't stand a chance against a top $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ investigator.」

27:t_1:24.en:
$$アルト$$
「The battles ahead will be even harsher... We can't take them into that.」

27:t_1:25.en:
$n
「We'll have $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ focus on defense... That's what we all agreed.」

27:t_1:27.en:
$n
「Do you think we're being too soft?」

27:t_1:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「No problem. It was the right decision.」

27:t_1:29.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Lately, I think I'm starting to understand what you meant when you told me not to bring battle into everyday life.」

27:t_1:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah... I'm glad you're all safe and sound.」

27:t_1:36.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So, everyone... Did you fill out your forms? The ones about your plans after graduation.」

27:t_1:38.en:
$$さやか$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ reminded us, too, but...」

27:t_1:39.en:
$$アルト$$
「Well... A lot's been going on...」

27:t_1:40.en:
$$かなめ$$
「By the looks of you, nobody did it.」

27:t_1:42.en:
$$かなめ$$
「There's still time before morning homeroom. Let's fill them out now.」

27:t_1:43.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Roger that, Madam Class Rep.」

27:t_1:44.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then let's go. Everyone in class has been wanting to see the $$ボランティア部$$ members, too.」

27:t_1:46.en:
$$甲児$$
「We haven't been to school in ten days.」

27:t_1:47.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Exactly. Come on, let's get going!」

27:t_1:49.en:
$n
「$$千鳥$$'s cheerfulness really keeps us going.」

27:t_1:51.en:
$n
「...$$宗介$$. Make sure you protect her.」

27:t_1:52.en:
$$宗介$$
「What's wrong, $n? That came out of nowhere...」

27:t_1:53.en:
$n
「...I don't know. I just felt like saying it.」

27:t_1:61.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Come on, guys... You could've filled out those forms wherever you were.」

27:t_1:62.en:
$$甲児$$
「We couldn't help it. We were busy with a lot of stuff.」

27:t_1:63.en:
$$詩織$$
「Where were you picking up trash this time?」

27:t_1:64.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Look, $$詩織$$... The $$ボランティア部$$ does more than pick up trash...」

27:t_1:67.en:
$$アルト$$
「We've explained it a million times...!」

27:t_1:68.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Hearing $$アルト$$'s angry comebacks puts my mind at ease.」

27:t_1:70.en:
$$詩織$$
「We were worried about you, you know. You kept doing volunteer work, even when you might not pass the year...」

27:t_1:71.en:
$$詩織$$
「And whenever you did come to school, you looked so tired.」

27:t_1:73.en:
$$さやか$$
「...Thank you. I'm sorry we worried you.」

27:t_1:74.en:
$$詩織$$
「Of course we were worried, $$さやか$$. We're classmates... We're friends.」

27:t_1:75.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Exactly. Besides, if you guys don't keep at it, who's gonna fix the bike shed's leaky roof?」

27:t_1:76.en:
$$アルト$$
「So that's what this was about!」

27:t_1:77.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「That's the spirit. I'm counting on you, Mr. $$ボランティア部$$ President.」

27:t_1:80.en:
$$風間$$
「...I've been wondering. $$竹尾ワッ太$$ is a member of the $$ボランティア部$$, too, right?」

27:t_1:81.en:
$$恭子$$
「You mean that cheerful company president who's still in elementary school?」

27:t_1:82.en:
$$風間$$
「$$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$'s $$トライダーＧ７$$ apparently fought all over during the 《$$時獄戦役$$》, but...」

27:t_1:83.en:
$$風間$$
「Could $$相良$$ and everyone in the $$ボランティア部$$ be...?」

27:t_1:84.en:
$$恭子$$
「You really love this kind of stuff, $$風間$$.」

27:t_1:85.en:
$$恭子$$
「You're overthinking it. $$カナ$$ said $$相良$$ is just a war nut.」
